title: Make playwright a dependency so the browser suites run from a clean checkout (OC-3)
objective: Neither browser suite runs from a clean checkout because playwright is not a dependency here, unlike the leaderboard's; both suites and the console rehearsal accept UI3_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE and were run pointed at the sibling's installed copy. Add playwright (and its browsers) as a proper dev dependency with the same pin the leaderboard uses, so a fresh clone can run tests/ui3-browser.mjs, tests/s1-browser.mjs and tests/console-rehearsal.mjs without the sibling. Source: former tracker row OC-3, preserved in docs/archive/TASK-TRACKER-2026-09-19-pre-readoption.md.
acceptance: npm ci on a clean checkout followed by the two browser suites and the console rehearsal succeeds without UI3_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE set.
The pin matches the leaderboard's so both products test on the same browser build; docs/VALIDATION.md records the run.
non_goals: No change to what the suites test.
No merge, deployment, live-data mutation, or account change unless separately authorized.

handoff.next_action: Read how tests/ui3-browser.mjs resolves UI3_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE, then add the dependency and run both suites from a fresh clone.
